text:
Maria: quick heads-up — canary at 10% started at 08:15 UTC and I'm seeing repeated SDK parse errors from a few customers. anyone else seeing this?

Ryan: which error are we getting? stack trace or sample payload would help.

Maria: paste from the logs: 
```
TypeError: expected object, got null
 at parseResponse (sdk/lib/parse.js:45)
 at processRequest (sdk/index.js:123)
```
And one of the raw responses that triggered it: `{"id":"abc","choices":null}` — looks like SDK expects choices to be an array.

Lucy: ah — SDK 1.4.2 has a defensive fallback for `choices === null` -> `[]`, but it looks like the published package is still 1.4.1 for the CDN. packaging step might have failed in the release pipeline.

Sandeep: runtime should probably not emit `choices: null`. Model adapter change yesterday had a path that returns null for empty output. We should short-circuit to `[]` server-side too. I can ship a tiny guard.

Maya: let's pause canary until we confirm fixes — want to avoid triggering downstream bugs in customer apps. +1 to server-side guard and republish SDK.

Ryan: agreed. Maria can you flip canary to 0% and hold? Also we need an ownership list and quick action items: SDK publish owner, runtime guard owner, QA signoff, comms if we hit customers.

Maria: pausing canary now — done at 08:27 UTC. traffic routed to fallback model.

Ryan: owners: SDK publish -> Lucy; runtime guard & hotfix -> Sandeep; rollout/rollback coordination & comms -> Maya; QA smoke/regress -> qa-bot. Ryan: I'll follow up on the release blockers if any.

Lucy: I will cut 1.4.2 (includes `if (!choices) choices = [];`), run the package CI, and publish to CDN. expecting ~2h due to CI queue. I will post the package link here when live.

Sandeep: I'll open a tiny PR to normalize `choices` before serialization and schedule a canary deploy to the runtime fleet. ETA ~30m for PR->canary patch.

qa-bot: once SDK artifact is published + runtime guard is on canary, run `migration_v2_smoke` test set and post results. please @qa-bot when both are complete.

Maria: logged actions in the migration board: https://boards.internal/r/RED-679 (notes + owners).

Ryan: action checklist for follow-ups:
- Lucy: publish 1.4.2 and tag release notes (include unit covering `choices === null`).
- Sandeep: deploy runtime guard to canary and report canary health.
- qa-bot: run smoke/regress and post failures.
- Maya: prep quick customer-facing blurb in case we need to notify early adopters.

Lucy: started CI pipeline just now. will drop the CDN URL here once available.

Sandeep: PR is up: https://git.internal/r/infra/normalize-choices PR#432 — running internal CI then will auto-deploy to canary.

qa-bot: queued `migration_v2_smoke`. status: awaiting artifacts (SDK 1.4.2) + runtime canary.

Maya: if anything looks flaky after canary we might hold the v2 rollout for 24h. I'll draft the blurb in #product-digest and share here for approval.

Maria: thanks all — I'll keep this thread as the source of truth for this issue. ping if you need escalations. :thumbsup:
